title.zh: 《天地有大美》2026袁之靜水墨創作展
title.en: “The Great Beauty of Heaven and Earth” — 2026 Yuan Chih-Jin Ink Painting Exhibition

venue.zh: 國立彰化生活美學館 第一、二展覽室
venue.en: National Changhua Living Art Center, Galleries 1 & 2

note.zh: 策展人賴慕芬。63 件新作首度公開：山水、月亮、帆船、抽象、花鳥五大系列。8/29 開幕茶會逾 300 位來賓；10/8 與國美館館長陳貺怡對談。
note.en: Curated by Lai Mu-fen. 63 new works in five series — landscapes, moons, sailboats, abstraction, flowers and birds. Over 300 guests at the August 29 opening; October 8 conversation with NTMoFA Director Chen Kuang-yi.

title.zh: 〔擺盪之水〕臺灣當代藝術中的伏流與漫延（2026 威尼斯雙年展衛星展）
title.en: “Unstable Waters: Undercurrents and Diffusions in Contemporary Art from Taiwan” (2026 Venice Biennale satellite exhibition)

venue.zh: 義大利威尼斯 亞布里奇宮（Palazzo Albrizzi-Capello）
venue.en: Palazzo Albrizzi-Capello, Venice, Italy

note.zh: 策展人黃智陽；與黃光男、杜忠誥、李蕭錕、羅振賢等 34 位臺灣當代水墨書畫藝術家聯展。
note.en: Curated by Huang Chih-yang, with 34 contemporary Taiwanese ink and calligraphy artists including Huang Kuang-nan, Tu Chung-kao, Li Hsiao-kun and Luo Zhen-xian.

title.zh: 《上善若水》2026袁之靜水墨創作展
title.en: “The Highest Good Is Like Water” — 2026 Yuan Chih-Jin Ink Painting Exhibition

venue.zh: 臺中榮民總醫院 門診大樓 2 樓大廳
venue.en: Taichung Veterans General Hospital, Outpatient Building 2F Lobby

note.zh: 展題取自老子《道德經》「上善若水，水善利萬物而不爭」，以水墨向醫者仁心致敬。主視覺〈上善若水－浩瀚伊瓜蘇〉（5×12 尺）。4/21 開幕，並捐贈書法作品〈上善若水〉予臺中榮總。
note.en: The title comes from Laozi's Tao Te Ching: “The highest good is like water; water benefits all things and does not compete.” A tribute to the compassion of doctors, centered on “The Highest Goodness: Boundless Iguazu” (5 × 12 chi, about 1.5 × 3.6 m). At the April 21 opening she donated the calligraphy work “The Highest Good Is Like Water” to the hospital.

title.zh: 《山水相逢》袁之靜師生創作展
title.en: “Where Mountains Meet Waters” — Yuan Chih-Jin and Students

venue.zh: 雲林縣政府文化觀光處展覽館
venue.en: Yunlin County Cultural Affairs and Tourism Department Exhibition Hall

note.zh: 67 件師生作品；參展學員多已持續創作十年以上。6/6 開幕茶會。學員：吳淑瑛、林麗玲、曹文娟、董妙玲、趙美鳳、廖麗華、劉惠花、賴秀玉、蘇月燕。
note.en: 67 works by the artist and nine long-time students, most of whom have painted with her for over a decade. Opening reception June 6.

title.zh: 《遇見．武陵》袁之靜水墨創作展
title.en: “Encountering Wuling” — Yuan Chih-Jin Ink Painting Exhibition

venue.zh: 武陵富野渡假村
venue.en: Fuye Resort Wuling, Taichung

note.zh: 武陵「藝文列車」首展，晴美方圓文化藝術基金會策劃。山水、心象、花鳥三系列共 60 餘件作品，展於大廳、廊道與餐廳。
note.en: The first show of Wuling's art series, curated with the Ching Mei Fang Yuan Culture and Arts Foundation: 60+ works in three series — landscapes, inner images, flowers and birds — throughout the resort.
